classification.rationale: Unfinished forklifts with essential character of the complete machine go with the complete article under GRI 2(a), heading 8427; not electric so 8427.20; LPG forklifts are typically rider-type counterbalanced, line 8427.20.40. Search surfaced no matching ruling.
